description: This file defines a Java interface named PubSubFactory, which provides methods for starting distributed publication and subscription components within a pub-sub system, parameterized by message type.

classes.name: PubSubFactory
classes.description: A generic interface for a pub-sub factory that can start distributed publication and subscription services.

methods.name: startDistributedPub
methods.description: Starts and returns access to a distributed publication service within the pub-sub system.

methods.name: startDistributedSub
methods.description: Starts and returns access to a distributed subscription service within the pub-sub system.
